I have successfully resolved the issue.

### Root Cause
`split_bill` in `billing.py` was calculating a single rounded share `share = round((total_cents + tip) / people)` and multiplying it by `people`. When the total amount did not divide evenly by the number of people, this caused all people to receive the exact same base share, rather than distributing the remainder cents to the first few people as specified by the requirements ("when it doesn't divide evenly, the first people pay the extra cents").

### Fix
Updated `split_bill` in `billing.py` to calculate the integer division `base_share = total_with_tip // people` and `remainder = total_with_tip % people`, then allocate `base_share + 1` to the first `remainder` people and `base_share` to the remaining people.

### Files Changed
- `billing.py`
